request.query: bounded integer polynomial family collision for a finite tuple of remainders modulo a monic polynomial

items.name: Polynomial.sum_modByMonic_coeff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] {p q : Polynomial R},
  q.Monic → ∀ {n : ℕ}, q.degree ≤ ↑n → ∑ i, (Polynomial.monomial ↑i) ((p %ₘ q).coeff ↑i) = p %ₘ q

items.name: Polynomial.self_mul_modByMonic
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] {p q : Polynomial R}, q.Monic → q * p %ₘ q = 0

items.name: Polynomial.exists_eq_polynomial
items.type:
∀ {Fq : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Fq] [inst_1 : Semiring Fq] {d m : ℕ},
  Fintype.card Fq ^ d ≤ m →
    ∀ (b : Polynomial Fq),
      b.natDegree ≤ d →
        ∀ (A : Fin m.succ → Polynomial Fq),
          (∀ (i : Fin m.succ), (A i).degree < b.degree) → ∃ i₀ i₁, i₀ ≠ i₁ ∧ A i₁ = A i₀

items.name: Polynomial.mul_self_modByMonic
